c46f2a94cc7111e85ac9.description:
**About Blueprint**

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

**In This Role**

In this role, you will support the end-to-end management of business guest credentials for a large enterprise organization. You will serve as a primary point of contact for business guests, managers, administrators, and internal stakeholders, ensuring requests are handled efficiently and information remains accurate and up to date. Your responsibilities will include coordinating onboarding and offboarding, tracking credential renewals and end dates, responding to inquiries, and assisting with access and IT-related needs. You will also coordinate device requests and returns when needed and provide support for additional credential management activities. This remote role is well suited for an organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys structured administrative work, clear communication, and keeping day-to-day operations running smoothly.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end business guest credential management process, including onboarding, offboarding, renewals, and credential end dates.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business guests, managers, administrators, and internal stakeholders regarding credential-related questions and requests.
* Monitor shared inboxes, respond to email inquiries, and ensure requests are triaged, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate business guest records, credential information, status updates, and tracking reports.
* Assist business guests with onboarding-related access issues and basic IT support needs, coordinating with appropriate support teams when necessary.
* Coordinate device requests, distribution logistics, and device returns while maintaining accurate records.
* Communicate updates, outstanding actions, and potential delays to relevant stakeholders to ensure visibility and consistent follow-through.
* Support additional credential management activities, administrative requests, and ad hoc operational tasks as business needs evolve.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of experience in administrative support, business operations, coordination, or a related role.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage inquiries and coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring tasks, competing priorities, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate records, track requests, and follow established processes through completion.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining a consistent schedule and responsive communication.
* Reliable follow-through, a proactive approach to managing inboxes and requests, and the ability to identify items requiring additional attention.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting administrative operations within a large enterprise, corporate, or technology-focused organization.
* Experience coordinating employee, contractor, vendor, or business guest onboarding and offboarding.
* Familiarity with credential lifecycle management, access requests, account administration, or identity and access management processes.
* Experience managing shared inboxes, service requests, tracking logs, status reports, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience coordinating IT equipment requests, device distribution, returns, or inventory tracking.
* Experience using Excel and SharePoint to maintain records, manage documentation, and track operational activities.
* Experience supporting process-driven workflows that require accuracy, confidentiality, consistency, and minimal supervision.
* Relevant hands-on experience in administrative or business support; a degree is not required in place of applicable experience.

**Compensation**

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

The anticipated compensation range is $15 to $16 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate's qualifications.

**Benefits**

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Competitive paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

eb5bae560e17a935fa2f.description:
### **About Zūm:**

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (*Zūm CMX*™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – *Zūm CMX* is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 6,500 schools rely on *Zūm CMX*. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

**About the Role**

We're seeking an experienced Dispatcher to lead daily transportation operations and serve as the critical communication hub at our Philadelphia, PA location. This role encompasses the complete dispatch lifecycle—from daily route assignments and driver coordination to emergency response and real-time problem-solving. You'll ensure seamless service delivery by orchestrating drivers, vehicles, and routes while maintaining constant communication with school districts, families, and internal teams. You'll be the operational heartbeat of our transportation service, ensuring every student gets to school safely and on time, every single day.

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

You're the calm in the storm, the person who can juggle ten things at once and still remember to check in on that driver who's running five minutes behind. You thrive when the phones are ringing, routes need adjusting, and a bus just broke down on Main Street. You're a quick thinker who stays cool under pressure, makes smart decisions on the fly, and somehow manages to keep everyone informed and on track. You genuinely enjoy being the go-to problem solver, whether you're helping a new driver navigate an unfamiliar route, coordinating with the shop on a repair, or reassuring a parent that their child's bus is on the way. You've got great communication skills, a knack for prioritizing what matters most, and the kind of steady, reliable presence that makes people trust you to get things handled.

**Responsibilities**

**Daily Operations & Route Managemen**t

Direct and monitor daily assignments, schedule drivers, and assign vehicles to ensure full route coverage and on-time completion of all driver activitiesCommunicate all relevant details of driving assignments to drivers to ensure proper execution, and assist with routing directions and special service assignmentsCoordinate vehicle service and repairs with the Maintenance Manager to ensure uninterrupted service delivery

**Communication & Emergency Response**

Respond to emergency calls and coordinate the emergency response networkNotify stakeholders and location personnel of all route changes, emergencies, accidents, breakdowns, or service disruptions, and handle customer concerns promptly and professionallyProvide real-time operational support to drivers including assistance with traffic issues, routing questions, and emergency situations, escalating unresolved issues appropriatelyCompliance &

**Administrative Operations**

Maintain route documentation and records including contracts, customer information, route changes, maps, vehicle assignments, and driver details to ensure accuracy and compliance with district and state requirementsEnsure strict adherence to dispatch standard operating procedures and recommend disciplinary action for policy violations in coordination with managementTrack and document operational activities, incidents, and communications for reporting purposes while partnering with Location Manager and Safety Manager on compliance objectives

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

High school diploma or equivalentProficiency with Microsoft or G Suite applications (Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.)

Experience in high-pressure, time-sensitive operations (e.g., transportation, logistics, field services, customer service, hospitality, or similar fast-paced environments)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Background in a leadership, supervisory, or management capacity within fast-paced operational environmentsPrevious school busing or transportation experience, either as a driver or dispatcher is a plus

Knowledge of state DOT/DMV safety rules and company compliance expectations

Excellent oral and written communication skills with strong interpersonal abilities

Experience working in a union environment

Comprehensive knowledge of the local area, including traffic patterns, road restrictions, neighborhoods, and geography of the school district is highly desirable

Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, coordinate scheduling and task assignments, maintain accurate records and filing systems, and track assets and inventory

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity, or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more.

fe6fa5a11433df0581e8.description:
**Position Overview**

The Writing Barn is seeking an Event Logistics Coordinator to serve as our back-up Technical Assistant (TA) for live virtual events.

This role is about **14 hours a month,** but it's worth noting that many of our now full-time staff started in similar part-time positions, and TWB has a strong culture of expanding team members' roles and hiring from within as we grow.

We have multiple online events a month and want to avoid scrambling if/when a team member has a last-minute scheduling conflict. This person would step in to manage live virtual events when our main TA staff is unavailable.

We have moderator instructions, but we can't possibly anticipate every potential issue, so we need someone who can think on their feet and use their best judgment to problem-solve on the fly.

Key Responsibilities

**Live Event Management & Technical Support**

* Open and manage Zoom or Google Meet rooms for live virtual events.
* Manage Zoom and Google Meet settings to ensure sessions run smoothly.
* Make sure sessions are being recorded.
* Admit participants and manage access to virtual events.
* Assist guest speakers with screen sharing and other technical needs.
* Manage chat and provide support to participants during live sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and problem-solve on the fly.
* Prioritize competing requests and manage multiple needs when participants or speakers require assistance at the same time.
* Follow moderator instructions while using good judgment to address unexpected situations.

**Administrative Support**

Since this is an "on-call" position, but we want your schedule to be predictable, the hours would be set. In the event that our main TA staff IS available, you would focus on admin projects during that time instead.

Those projects might include:

* Data entry
* Online research
* Other administrative tasks, nothing too technical

Schedule & Availability

The person in this role would need to have online availability during the following hours:

* **Monday evenings:** 5:45 p.m. to 7:45 p.m. CT
* **Two Saturdays each month (typically third and fourth):** 9:45 a.m. to 11:45 a.m. CT

We hope to add more hours as we expand our events schedule.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal person is:

* Online and reachable during the required hours.
* Comfortable running a Zoom or Google Meet room or online event, including managing platform settings.
* Good with on-the-spot problem-solving.
* Able to prioritize competing requests and respond effectively when multiple people need assistance at once during a live event.
* Detail-oriented with strong admin skills.
* Comfortable thinking on their feet and using their best judgment to handle unexpected situations.
* Interested in learning about kidlit publishing!

**About Our Events**

Our events all center on kidlit publishing, and our guest speakers are usually agents, editors, or authors who work in the industry and are sharing their expertise with emerging writers.

**Growth Opportunities**

Many of our now full-time staff started in similar part-time positions, and TWB has a strong culture of expanding team members' roles and hiring from within as we grow.

We hope to add more hours to this position as we expand our events schedule.

Job Types: Part-time, Contract

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

72a75d16a82473627f4b.title: Social Media Content Coordinator (PT) - Remote
72a75d16a82473627f4b.description:
**About:**

**Are you always ahead of the latest social media trends and passionate about brand storytelling? At Vanguard College Prep, we are seeking a detail-oriented Social Media Content Coordinator to manage and elevate our digital presence across all social channels. In this role, you will plan, create, and schedule daily engaging content across all our social channels. You will craft eye-catching visual and video assets, manage community interactions, and analyze post performance to drive measurable growth and engagement while fostering meaningful connections with our online community.**

**Compensation:**

* Starting Compensation: **$16.00 – $19.00** depending on education, experience, and skill.
  + Work from home, occasional commute
  + Flexible Schedule
  + Career growth opportunities

**What You'll Do:**

* ### **Content Creation & Curation**

* **Short-Form Video Production:** Script, film, and edit vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using mobile editors like CapCut or desktop tools like Adobe Premiere Pro.
* **Graphic & Visual Asset Design:** Create static graphics, carousel posts, infographics, and story assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* **Copywriting:** Draft engaging captions, call-to-actions (CTAs), video scripts, and post copy tailored to each platform's distinct tone and audience.
* **Brand Voice Maintenance:** Ensure all visual design choices, messaging, and tone strictly follow established brand guidelines.

* ### **Planning & Scheduling**

* **Editorial Calendar Management:** Build and maintain weekly/monthly content calendars aligned with product launches, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events.
* **Content Scheduling:** Upload and schedule posts across platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Youtube) using scheduling platforms
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate with internal teams as needed to gather assets and information for upcoming posts.

* ### **Community Management**

* **Active Daily Engagement:** Monitor active feeds and inbox messages daily to respond to comments, direct messages (DMs), and mentions.
* **UGC Curation:** Identify user-generated content (UGC), engage with creators, and coordinate permissions to repurpose high-performing posts that apply to our brand.
* **Customer Support Routing:** Flag customer complaints, technical issues, or public relations risks appearing on social channels and route them to support or leadership teams.

* ### **Analytics & Reporting**

* **Analytics & Reporting:** Track key performance indicators (KPIs)—reach, impressions, engagement rates, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversions—and compile regular performance reports with actionable insights to optimize strategy.
* **Trend Identification:** Research viral audio clips, trending video formats, and emerging platform features to pitch timely content opportunities.
* **Competitor & Industry Monitoring:** Benchmark channel performance against industry trends and key industry competitors to refine publishing schedules and post styles.

### **Requirements:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or higher
* **Work Experience:** A minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts, producing digital content, and/or coordinating organic social campaigns for a brand, business, or agency.
* **Communication Skills:** Ability to write clear, engaging post copy, short hooks, and clear calls-to-action (CTAs) that match a brand's specific voice and tone.
* **Analytical Skills:** Ability to read social media platform insights (engagement rate, reach, impressions, click-throughs) and turn metrics into actionable content adjustments.
* **Work Setup:** Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for video content production
* **Tech Proficiency:** Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, social media platforms for posting content, and video editing platforms such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop etc.

### **The ideal candidate will also possess:**

* The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
* Excellent content creation and editing skills
* Ability to create growth in the number of followers across all platforms
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to be able to meet content posting goals and create content when viral trends emerge
* Manage multiple deadlines and content pipelines simultaneously
* Experience with meeting social media related goals set by organizations
* Ability to optimize post captions, alt text, and video metadata for social search engines using strategic keywords.

**Why Work With Us?**

* **Meaningful Impact:** You will be able to provide the opportunity for more students to be able to use our services through social media reach
* **Career Growth:** Opportunities for leadership and long-term career growth
* **Elite Peer Network:** Join a tight-knit team that shares resources, celebrates wins, and supports each other through ongoing professional development and mentorship. Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and mentorship.
* **Fully Remote Flexibility:** Enjoy the autonomy of working from home with regular team collaboration and support.
* **Comprehensive Paid Onboarding:** We invest heavily in your success with structured training covering our academic frameworks, objection handling, and marketing strategies.

**About Us:**

Vanguard College Prep is dedicated to equipping students with the strategic tools, expert test preparation, and personalized college counseling needed to confidently navigate an increasingly complex admissions system. As the education industry rapidly evolves, we are expanding our reach to ensure as many families as possible can access our top-tier programs and empower their students to reach their full potential. Our mission is to serve our community by creating future leaders that will revolutionize their respective fields.

601851307ed236ed3b1b.description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this****link****directly.**

  

**Who we are**

Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.

Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.

At **Emphasys PHA**, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Technical Operations Manager, we are looking for a **Technical Support Specialist**. As our new Technical Support Specialist you will be part of a team providing front-line technical expertise across our hosted environments, taking ownership of escalated issues related to Azure Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), MSIX App Streaming, SQL performance, and application deployment pipelines. You will work closely with our Infrastructure, Development, and Product teams to troubleshoot, document, and improve the reliability, performance and security of our technical operations.

*This is a full-time, fully remote position within the US.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Breadth and depth.* You will deepen your expertise in modern cloud platforms and deployment tools while building hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies—from virtual desktops and SQL databases to application deployment pipelines. Your work will support essential systems used by government clients to manage funding, determine program eligibility, and allocate resources within their communities.

*A collaborative culture.* You will join a close-knit support team trusted with high-priority issues and critical environments. While much of your time will be spent on ticket resolution, your input on optimization, documentation, and internal tooling will be valued.

*Career growth.* You will receive direct mentorship from seasoned leaders and collaborate with a skilled team where teaching is prioritized. Whether you want to grow your role on this team, another area of Emphasys, or as part of the larger Aquila team, you will be supported in your career development.

**As our new Technical Support Specialist, you will:**

* **Support Azure-hosted environments.** You will provide tier 1 and 2 support across Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), SQL databases, MSIX app streaming, and related Microsoft services. You will support cloud migrations and environment upgrades by performing environment testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* **Resolve technical issues.** You will respond to a range of tickets, including password resets, printing issues, environment access, SQL errors, and plug-in failures. You will troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate problems based on priority, escalating when necessary.
* **Manage and optimize deployments.** You will assist with managing CI/CD pipelines, primarily using Octopus Deploy, and help automate processes for application updates and patches.
* **Work across server technologies.** You will interact with IIS, Active Directory, File Servers, Domain Controllers, and API Servers to support performance, access, and integrations. You will assist with database backups, restores, and disaster recovery to ensure continuity and performance.
* **Document, track, and improve.** You will log incident reports, resolution steps, and system notes in the internal ticketing system. You will identify opportunities to improve documentation, streamline support tasks, and share knowledge with peers.

**You bring:**

* **The customer service focus.** You have professional, adaptable communication skills and can explain technical issues clearly to a range of non-technical stakeholders. You are patient and maintain a professional, empathetic tone when handling support requests. You document resolutions thoroughly and thrive in a role that balances independence with collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
* **The experience.** You have worked in a technical support or systems role, with knowledge of Azure Virtual Desktop, SQL troubleshooting, and virtual application delivery. You have used CI/CD tools such as Octopus Deploy or similar and understand their function in deployment pipelines.
* **The analytical mindset.** You are confident analyzing logs, tracing issues across interconnected systems, and solving technical problems with urgency and creativity. You balance support tickets with deeper troubleshooting and proactive monitoring.

**Join us.**

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor will be scheduled to discuss your interest in the role and share your relevant experience.
* A virtual technical interview with the Technical Operations Manager and the Director of Development. This will be an opportunity for you to ask further questions about the role and team.
* A final virtual interview with the CEO for you to share more about your interest in the role and team as well as ask any questions around the company trajectory and culture.

Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. 67a2a065708a15584ae0.description:
Job Description
  
  
It is critical that consistent, accurate, high-quality data is generated and maintained from clinical trials conducted worldwide. In collaboration with the Clinical Quality Operations Lead (CQOL) and Head of CQO, the CQOM is responsible for the execution of clinical quality oversight activities within an assigned trial. This includes proactive quality management, risk-based quality oversight, and clinical trial inspection management activities.
  
  
The CQOM will provide clinical quality operations support to Trial Teams (TTs) to proactively embed quality into sponsored trials, ensure robust supplier oversight, and address critical quality issues as needed.
  
The incumbent will assist with the overall strategy for maintaining ongoing inspection readiness, as well as preparing for, managing, and following up on regulatory inspections.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities:**  
Trial Team, Research Portfolio and Enterprise Support
  
  

* Independently support assigned Trial Teams (TT) and drive implementation of Quality by Design.
* Act as a Process Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Clinical Quality Operations, providing guidance on quality processes, standards, and regulatory requirements to TTs.
* Support identification, investigation, escalation, and resolution of study-level quality issues including Significant Quality Issues (SQIs) and Serious Breaches (SBs).
* Support Trial Teams in assessing trial health and conducting quality reviews, as needed.
* Lead Inspection Hypercare Teams (IHT) with the aim of ensuring that, at all stages, the Trial Team (TT) maintains ongoing inspection readiness.

Regulatory GCP Inspections & Research and Development Quality Assurance Audits
  

* Provide oversight for operational management of sponsor inspections (e.g., act as Control Room Lead or Control Room Support).
* Act as Inspection Lead for site inspections.
* Conduct pre-inspection visit (PIV) for impending site inspections.
* Author key inspection communications (e.g., daily summaries, inspection outcomes, and issue escalations).
* Coordinate the inspection response process managing the root cause analysis, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) and associated regulatory commitments to completion, ensuring that key inspection documentation is maintained at all times.
* Support Quality Assurance audits (i.e., Study Level Audits) providing support to TT before, during and after audit, including coordinating root cause analysis for any applicable observations, development of responses, CAPA management and tracking.

Clinical Quality Risk Management
  

* Collaborate with the Clinical Quality Risk Manager (CQRM) to operationalize quality risk management during trial conduct.
* Provide critical insights from study level audits, inspections, and quality issues and support identification of actionable resolution pathways for quality signals that emerge during trial conduct.

Service Provider Quality Oversight
  

* Serve as the primary clinical quality Point of Contact (POC) for assigned key service providers (e.g., tier 1 and tier 2 service providers).
* Responsible for the strategic development and management of service provider clinical quality agreements.

Mergers & Acquisitions
  

* Support quality-related mergers and acquisitions activities, as required, to ensure comprehensive knowledge transfer, risk management, and inspection readiness.

CQO Infrastructure, Process Innovation & Special Projects
  

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CQO infrastructure and process innovation.
* Support and lead special projects and strategic assignments within CQO as assigned by CQOL.

AI Efficiency & Optimization
  

* Proactively identify and apply AI-driven approaches to improve operational efficiency and decision-making within CQO.
* Work with data and analytics to monitor performance and drive continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
  
  
Education
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree or equivalent in a health care or scientific area.

Experience
  
  

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry and/or clinical research.
* Robust knowledge of quality management and clinical trial operations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), ICH GCP guidelines, and worldwide Regulatory Health Authority requirements.
* Advanced experience in independent root cause analysis (RCA), CAPA development and effectiveness management, and service provider quality oversight.

Skills
  

* Superior oral and written communication skills in an international, matrixed environment.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams of business and clinical professionals.
* Able to act urgently and decisively on worldwide health authority inspection matters.
* Ability to analyze, interpret, and solve complex quality and compliance issues.

. Ability to think strategically and objectively with digital savvy (awareness of AI and machine learning tools)

0627af0554033f3dc42b.description:
**Description**

**Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000**

**About Designs for Health**  
Designs for Health is a trusted leader in the nutraceutical industry, known for delivering high-quality, research-driven nutritional products that support better health outcomes. For more than 30 years, we have combined scientific integrity, innovation, and a strong commitment to quality to earn the confidence of practitioners and customers alike.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Senior CRM Marketing Operations Analyst to serve as the functional owner and power user for Marketing's use of HubSpot. This remote role combines CRM operations, marketing analytics, and email and SMS execution to support business-to-business (B2B), patient-focused business-to-consumer (B2C), and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels.

The analyst owns Marketing-facing HubSpot processes, workflows, audiences, dashboards, campaign operations, and user enablement while partnering with Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative, Sales, IT, and other business teams. The role collaborates with the Senior CRM Sales Operations Analyst on shared customer and account data, lifecycle definitions, lead handoffs, integrations, and cross-functional reporting. The role also connects sales outcomes with customer insights while providing analysis, segmentation, and measurement support to campaign and lifecycle strategy owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional owner, senior power user, and subject matter expert for Marketing's use of HubSpot, including marketing processes, properties, lists, workflows, reports, dashboards, documentation, and usage standards.
* Analyze CRM, campaign, customer, and marketing-engagement data across B2B, patient-focused B2C, and DTC channels to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights.
* Build and maintain Marketing-facing HubSpot reports, dashboards, and performance summaries for Brand, Marketing, Customer Service, and leadership stakeholders; collaborate with the Sales CRM counterpart on shared funnel and revenue reporting.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads to define and maintain the strategic email and SMS content calendar, campaign schedule, automated flows, and related operational requirements.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads, copywriters, and Creative partners to move email and SMS content through development and ensure required copy, creative assets, audience criteria, and campaign details are ready for execution.
* Build, schedule, quality-check, and execute email and SMS campaigns and automated flows in HubSpot and connected tools, ensuring accurate audiences, links, timing, and tracking.
* Measure email and SMS performance, audience engagement, lead quality, conversion activity, and customer lifecycle outcomes and translate results into actionable recommendations.
* Develop and refine customer segments, targeting logic, campaign lists, suppression criteria, and audience-performance analysis in partnership with Brand Leads and other marketing stakeholders.
* Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of Marketing-owned CRM data, including audience, consent, campaign, engagement, and marketing-touchpoint information; coordinate changes to shared contact and company data with the Sales CRM counterpart.
* Own Marketing's business requirements and operational support for HubSpot integrations with marketing automation, business intelligence, and other connected systems; coordinate shared integrations and data flows with the Sales CRM counterpart, IT, Data, and system owners.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Marketing-facing CRM data discrepancies, workflow issues, integration errors, and reporting inconsistencies; partner with the Sales CRM counterpart and technical owners when issues affect shared data or processes.
* Establish and improve governance for Marketing-owned HubSpot processes, including audience and consent standards, naming conventions, campaign tracking, workflow documentation, and marketing data quality; jointly maintain shared lifecycle and handoff definitions with Sales.
* Provide HubSpot guidance, training, and documentation for Marketing users that promote adoption, consistent campaign practices, data discipline, and reliable decision-making.
* Collaborate with the broader Marketing team to support departmental initiatives, projects, and evolving business priorities as needed.

**Competency**

* **HubSpot Expertise:** Applies advanced platform knowledge to reporting, segmentation, workflows, email and SMS execution, data quality, integrations, and user enablement.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Interprets campaign, customer, CRM, and sales data and translates findings into practical recommendations.
* **Marketing Operations Acumen:** Understands email and SMS calendars, content workflows, campaign execution, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and performance measurement.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Keeps Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative partners, and technical stakeholders aligned on requirements, timing, dependencies, and execution readiness.
* **Data Accuracy & Governance:** Maintains strong attention to detail and promotes clean, structured, well-governed customer data.
* **Systems Thinking:** Understands how customer data flows across HubSpot and connected marketing, sales, ERP, and reporting platforms.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Works effectively across Marketing, Sales, IT, Data, and other business teams and establishes clear ownership for shared CRM processes.
* **Problem Solving:** Investigates root causes and recommends practical improvements to marketing data, campaign workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* **Process Orientation:** Creates repeatable practices, clear documentation, and consistent standards for CRM analytics and operations.
* **Adaptability:** Adjusts effectively to changing business priorities, evolving systems, and fast-moving marketing needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM operations, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, marketing analytics, customer data, or campaign execution and reporting.
* Required advanced, hands-on HubSpot experience, including reports and dashboards, segmentation, workflows, properties, lifecycle stages, data quality, email and SMS execution, and connected applications.
* Experience coordinating email and SMS content calendars, automated flows, audience segmentation, campaign quality assurance, scheduling, execution, and performance reporting.
* Experience coordinating content development with Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative teams, and other stakeholders while managing campaign requirements and timelines.
* Experience supporting CRM integrations, monitoring data flows, and troubleshooting synchronization or data-quality issues across connected systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience with Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or a similar business intelligence tool is a plus.
* Working knowledge of CRM data structures, lead and customer lifecycle stages, marketing funnels, email and SMS campaign tracking, and customer segmentation.
* Ability to analyze, synthesize, and present complex CRM, campaign, and customer data in clear business language and translate stakeholder questions into reporting, segmentation, workflow, and data solutions.
* Experience partnering with Sales Operations on lifecycle definitions, lead handoffs, shared data governance, integrations, and cross-functional reporting is preferred.
* Understanding of data privacy, CRM governance, and email and SMS marketing compliance considerations, including CAN-SPAM and related best practices.
* Experience in nutraceuticals, CPG, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated or quality-focused environment is preferred.

**Benefits**

* You receive a competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* You benefit from health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* You receive a monthly product stipend to support your personal health journey.
* You have access to paid time off and company holidays.
* You work in a collaborative and supportive team environment.

**Physical Demands**

This position is primarily sedentary, requiring regular computer use and communication. Some tasks may involve moving within the office environment or occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

**Privacy**

Your application for this position is subject to Designs for Health's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Workforce Members. Designs for Health does not sell your personal information, nor does Designs for Health share it for purposes of cross-context behavioral advertising.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging**

Designs for Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can grow and thrive. Our employees form meaningful and often life-long connections while working at Designs for Health. We are all passionate about our mission of designing a well world together.

**Reports To**

Sr. Director of Marketing Operations

**About Keystone Technologies:**

Founded in 1945, Keystone Technologies is a third-generation, family-owned business headquartered in the Greater Philadelphia area. A national leader in the commercial and industrial lighting industry, Keystone reaches customers across the U.S. with its mission of "Light Made Easy."

**Who We Are:**

We’re not your typical lighting company — and we like it that way. At Keystone, we move fast, think big, and challenge the status quo to deliver on our promise of Light Made Easy®. Our team thrives on new ideas, supports one another, aims high, works hard, and laughs often. And we always put people first — whether that’s our customers, partners, or each other. If you’re passionate about growing, collaborating, and making a difference, you’ll feel right at home here.

**Keystone's core values:**

* **Wow Customers:** Every interaction is an opportunity to show how much we care and appreciate all our customers, internal and external, so we create unique experiences that go above and beyond their expectations.
* **Grow Passionately:** We embrace growth through creativity, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn. Our work isn’t just about achieving more; it’s about evolving personally and professionally, transforming at every opportunity.
* **Do Right:** It’s not just good ethics to do the right thing; it’s good business. We uphold the highest integrity, and we do the right thing even when it’s hard. Why? Because trust is our most important currency.
* **Value People:** We come from a range of backgrounds, affiliations, and experiences. We honor everybody’s story and build lifelong relationships, whether with colleagues, customers, or partners, because to reach our fullest potential means empowering people to thrive.
* **Challenge Convention:** We refuse to blindly accept the status quo. With agility, courage, and tenacity, we continuously improve — asking tough questions, looking beyond surfaces, and not stopping to rest on our accomplishments.

**What you bring:**

* 1-2 years of sales experience in similar inside sales role

* Lighting industry experience and product knowledge required

4e3e3432445792c10085.title: Senior Associate, Account Manager
4e3e3432445792c10085.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Account Manager to join our team. The Account Manager will be responsible for retaining our top ARR clients & pooled plans and providing exceptional service to ensure client satisfaction and loyalty. Successful candidates will be responsible for supporting incoming employer plan inquiries, change orders, proactive outreaches, ongoing client reviews, and supporting multiple cross-functional teams across the organization. In addition, the Account Manager will have the flexibility to jump into other service teams and provide coverage and support as needed.

Our mission-driven service teams are often the first point of contact for customers, so we are interested in hiring individuals with a passion for providing memorable client experiences with the ability to make quick and accurate decisions. As a Vestweller, you are a dynamic individual who will work cross-functionally across teams to communicate and facilitate resolutions for any client satisfaction issues.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

As a Senior Associate, Employer Services Account Manager, you will act as a strategic, independent contributor responsible for managing and growing high-value employer client relationships. This is role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and autonomy to resolve complex plan and service issues. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless, high-quality service experience.  
  
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* **Client Relationship Management:** Independently manage and retain relationships with top ARR clients and pooled plans across Vestwell platforms, addressing post-onboarding needs such as plan design changes, year-end testing, education, and ongoing inquiries.
* **Strategic Advisory:** Work closely with clients to understand business goals and challenges, identifying opportunities to introduce additional Vestwell products and solutions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with internal teams—including Product, Operations, and Legal & Compliance—to resolve complex client issues, escalate when appropriate, and ensure client needs are met efficiently.
* **Proactive Outreach & Service Optimization:** Conduct proactive outreach to identify service gaps, platform opportunities, and relay the voice of the client to internal stakeholders.
* **Process & Playbook Development:** Design and document account management processes, playbooks, and resources to improve operational efficiency and support team growth.
* **Problem Solving & Escalation Management:** Handle escalated complaints, troubleshoot complex issues, recommend solutions, and coordinate with Legal and Compliance when necessary.
* **Client Communication & Trust-Building:** Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound client inquiries, communicating clearly, professionally, and empathetically to foster long-term relationships.
* **Documentation & Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of client interactions, service tickets, and account updates in internal systems to ensure transparency, continuity, and audit readiness.
* **Service Level Adherence & Workload Management:** Prioritize and manage workload effectively, meeting client-facing and internal Service Level expectations while exercising independent judgment.

**Requirements**

The Necessities:

* College degree and/or equivalent customer service experience
* 2-4 years of retirement industry experience, preferred
* Team mentality and the ability to multitask while attending to a high volume of incoming inquiries
* Strong time management and organizational skills to ensure the timeliness of all proactive and reactive communications
* Strong commitment to superior customer service
* Positive and proactive attitude
* Proficiency is required with Excel/Google Sheets, Word/Google Docs, Adobe Acrobat, and browsing network directories as we are a paperless office
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy, proficient with numbers and basic calculations

  

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation. For exceptional candidates, we're open to hiring this role fully remote.  
  
The expected base salary range for this position is $60K - $80K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. 5de3302bfaa1ce7926c6.title: Patient Access Liaison II - MBH South Phila.
5de3302bfaa1ce7926c6.description:
**Malvern Behavioral Health** is seeking a full-time **Patient Access Liaison II** to work at our acute inpatient behavioral health facility located at 1930 S Broad Street, Philadelphia PA 19145. The Patient Access Liaison II is a full-time position that reports up through our Finance department. The position offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefit package!

The Patient Access Liaison II is responsible to research/verify, patient healthcare coverage and benefits, along with payer requirements for reimbursement. This individual will handle all insurance verification by using the insurance portals as needed. Such as Promise (EVS), NaviNet, Availity and PEAR Portals. Will be responsible for calling the insurance company and obtaining the most recent benefit details, obtaining information regarding authorization and claim submission. They will have conversations with patients regarding their insurance coverage and benefit details along with collecting any Out-of-Pocket balances. They will be responsible for updating the billing system and ensuring all insurance verification documentation is attached to the individual’s account. They will work closely with multiple departments such as Admissions, Utilization Management; and Patient Accounting.

**Summary of Essential Position Functions:**

* Extensive time of communication via phone with patients/responsible parties, Insurance providers and/or managed care companies.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of patient information following the HIPPA guidelines.
* Accurate data entry of insurance/benefit and payer requirement information into computer system
* Provides excellent customer service to patients and families.
* Verifies insurance benefits to make sure plans are active and has no termination date showing in the immediate future, as well as verify any financial obligations such as deductibles, co-insurance, and co-pays that the patient would be responsible for.
* Communicates with supervisor on admissions that need payment plans for admissions.
* Calculate patient responsibility and explain benefit details to patients.
* Clearly explain estimated out of pocket responsibilities. Insurance coverage limits and policy benefits directly to patients or guarantors.
* Upfront collections will be expected. You will be responsible for requesting and accepting payments (estimated balances) via credit card or check.
* Concisely, and accurately document all information on the account and scan documents into the patients’ account.
* If patient is a prior patient, check billing system for prior balances outstanding. Explain prior balances to patients and assist in setting up a payment plan for prior patient activity balances.
* Assist the admission team by obtaining all pertinent information along with having admission documentation signed as needed.

**Benefits Offered for the Patient Access Liaison II position include: Medical, Dental, Vision coverage. A 401K offering with a company match! Free life insurance, free long term disability policy and paid time off!**

* Participates in continuing education (in- services & other training) to achieve professional growth.
* Perform other duties assigned to support Malvern Health’s vision and values.

**Qualifications:** To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. This position requires individuals that are client focused; team oriented; great interpersonal and communication skills; flexible to sudden changes in workload, emergency or staffing; dependable; problem solving skills; focused on compliance and performance quality. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education and/or Experience:** High school diploma or equivalent required, bachelor’s degree preferred. Knowledge of addictive diseases preferred. Healthcare, Admissions, Insurance experience a plus.

**Technical/Computer Skills:** MS Office, billing software, telephone, and other office equipment.

**Work Environment and Hazards:** No hazardous conditions. Weather protected.

**Physical Requirements:** Sedentary work – lifting 10 lbs. maximum and occasionally lifting and/or carrying such articles as patient charts, binders, letters, and small tools. Involves sitting and a certain amount of walking and standing occasionally to carry out job duties. Communication is required. Talking, expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word, and hearing, perceiving the nature of sounds by the ear, is required.

5d078fcafe18d2d74f26.title: Service Operations Coordinator – Scheduling, Dispatch & Administration
5d078fcafe18d2d74f26.description:
Mast RoofingConstruction in Oley, PA is seeking a full-time Service Operations Coordinator to keep our phones, appointment schedules, dispatch activities, and service administration running accurately and efficiently. This is a Client Care Representative position with substantial responsibility for coordinating the work behind every client interaction and helping turn incoming opportunities into completed, profitable work.

Answering a high volume of incoming calls is a central part of this role. Success also requires active thinking, independent judgment, and timely decisions. You will move between live calls, scheduling changes, technician needs, payments, and detailed administrative work throughout the day. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, anticipates problems, and follows through without waiting for repeated direction.

Annual earning potential is $45,000-$65,000, with a starting base of $22/hour+, DOE (depending on experience), plus performance incentives and bonus opportunities. Benefits include personalized training, paid holidays including your birthday, paid time off (PTO), medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, and an IRA retirement plan with a 100% company match up to 3%.

Are you quick-thinking, highly organized, and accurate under pressure? Can you listen closely, ask the right questions, and enter information directly into a computer system while keeping a conversation moving? If you enjoy solving scheduling problems, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of results, we would like to meet you.

**ABOUT MAST ROOFINGCONSTRUCTION**

We are a faith-based, family-run, full-service residential and light commercial roofing and construction company. For over 28 years, we have built our reputation by caring for our clients and delivering quality workmanship through expert training, technology, and industry experience.  
Our mission is simple: To honor God by serving those around us with excellence. Our Core Values - W.I.S.E. - guide how we work: Work Hard, With Integrity, Serving Others, and With Excellence. We value our employees and their families and encourage personal growth, skill development, and a positive, professional culture of ownership and accountability.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

You help set the pace for the day. You answer calls, identify client needs, book appointments, and keep the CRM current as conversations happen. You coordinate with sales and production, adjust schedules as priorities change, and help technicians arrive prepared. Between calls, you prepare production folders, process payments, track appointment outcomes, and make sure the next person has the information needed to do the job well.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Handle a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism, urgency, and accuracy. Work toward answering 98% of calls by the third ring and use a headset throughout the work shift to support efficient call handling.
* Maintain a minimum 80% booking ratio by using approved scripts, asking effective questions, explaining the value of our services, and addressing objections confidently and respectfully.
* Listen and type client information directly into the CRM during live conversations, without relying on handwritten notes for later entry. Capture contact details, service needs, commitments, and next steps completely and accurately.
* Respond to online quote requests within 5 minutes of submission, return client calls within 5 minutes, and respond to emails, texts, and calls daily in accordance with company procedures.
* Schedule repair and replacement appointments, service calls, estimates, and final 25 Point roof inspections. Confirm appointment details, start dates, times, and any changes promptly with clients and the appropriate staff.
* Coordinate and dispatch repair inspections and production calls under the direction of the Production Manager. Make proactive scheduling decisions within established guidelines to support profitable dispatching, productive technician time, efficient travel, and timely client service.
* Monitor the schedule for gaps, conflicts, delays, and changing priorities. Take action to keep
    
  appointments moving, communicate adjustments, and escalate decisions that exceed your authority.
* Generate sales orders in the CRM, record and verify appointment results, and follow up with the responsible staff when results or supporting details are missing. Keep administrative tracking systems updated daily.
* Prepare complete, accurate production and job folders, including jobs with signed proposals and deposits awaiting contracts. Ensure repair and replacement paperwork reaches the appropriate staff before appointments.
* Route required job pouches to management for commission entry and review. Transfer completed job folders to the Office Manager for invoicing and send contracts for electronic signatures as directed.
* Collect required payments and payment information on booked and confirmed calls, following company procedures for authorization, accurate processing, documentation, and protection of client information.
* Assist clients who choose financing and complete vendor warranty registrations after final invoicing. Track outstanding documents and follow through until required administrative steps are complete.
* Provide prompt support to technicians and sales representatives. Maintain clear communication so that client commitments, appointment requirements, and job information are understood across the team.
* Follow up daily with clients who have requested communication. Resolve service concerns promptly, respectfully, and with empathy; provide daily updates to the Sales Manager on escalated interactions and support a quality or recommendation score of at least 9/10 through PulseM or an equivalent system.
* Report directly to the Sales Manager, meet weekly to review goals and results, and attend meetings and required training prepared and on time. Participate in phone skills training at least twice yearly and help improve scripts and processes.
* Maintain organized records and work areas, meet reporting deadlines, and promptly notify management of serious accidents, damage, liability or warranty concerns, fraud, theft, or serious Core Value breaches.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

* Prior experience in service coordination, dispatch, appointment scheduling, client care, or administrative operations. Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or another trade service business is strongly preferred.
* Comfort managing a high volume of phone calls while completing time-sensitive scheduling, dispatch, and administrative responsibilities.
* Fast, accurate keyboarding and the ability to listen, ask questions, and type directly into a CRM during a live conversation without first taking handwritten notes. Strong typing speed must be matched by accuracy and complete records.
* Sound judgment and confidence making timely decisions within established procedures, with the ability to recognize when management input is needed.
* Proven ability to work independently, take initiative, anticipate needs, and follow responsibilities through to completion without repeated reminders.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to checking names, addresses, appointment times, payments, and job documentation for accuracy.
* Ability to shift quickly between tasks, manage interruptions, and maintain a productive pace in a busy environment with changing priorities and firm deadlines.
* Practical, analytical problem-solving skills and an understanding of how booking, scheduling, dispatch, and follow-up affect productivity, revenue, and profitability.
* Clear verbal and written communication, professional phone skills, and the ability to explain service options and respond to objections while treating clients respectfully.
* Confidence using CRM systems, scheduling tools, email, spreadsheets, and multiple computer applications, with the ability to learn new systems and follow established workflows.
* Integrity, discretion with confidential information, dependable attendance, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to accept coaching and improve performance.

**SERVICE AREAS**

This is a full-time onsite position at our company offices in Oley, PA, supporting clients and field operations throughout Berks County and surrounding areas, including Reading and Allentown, PA.

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM**

Do you enjoy taking ownership of a busy schedule, solving practical problems, and keeping details accurate while the phones are ringing? Are you ready to combine excellent client care with the initiative and judgment that help a service business succeed? If our mission, Core Values, and expectations resonate with you, complete our quick, mobile-friendly application today. All applications are confidential. We look forward to meeting you!

They are responsible for performing these functions while meeting the mission and goals of the organization and all regulatory compliance requirements. The Representative will work within the policies and processes as they are being performed across the entire organization.

Explains and distributes patient education documents, such as Important Message from Medicare, Important Message from Tricare, Observation Forms, MOON form, Consent forms, and all forms implemented for future services.
* Reviews eligibility responses in insurance verification system and appropriately selects the applicable insurance plan code, enters benefit data into system to support POS (Point of Service Collections) and billing processes to assist with a clean claim rate.
* Responsible for accurately screening of medical necessity using the Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN) software to inform Medicare patients of possible non-payment of test by Medicare and distribution of the ABN as appropriate. Responsible for distribution and documentation of other designated forms and pamphlets.

**Experience We Love:**

* Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

**Minimum Education:**

* High School Diploma/GED Required

**Certifications:**

* CRCR Required within 9 months of hire (Company Paid)

The Project Manager is responsible to advance the opportunities for continued growth in market share, profitability in specific service lines, practice areas and/or local market. Experience with ground up projects in the Hospitality sector is strongly preferred.

  

**Attributes to support the NELSON culture:**

* **Think Bold. Execute Smart.**We think boldly—and pair ambition with discipline.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over **100 years.**

  

**Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.**

The Pratt & Whitney **Digital MES team** has an exciting **remote** opportunity available for a **MES Business Analyst** supporting the Digital Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) tower.

**What You Will Do:**

Pratt & Whitney, an RTX company, is looking for a functional business analyst to join our PW Digital team, supporting the Digital Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) tower.

  

This individual will be involved in the delivery of designing, developing, enhancing, and implementing software solutions within Pratt & Whitney’s Center of Excellence (COE) for enterprise MES, as well as integrations with other enterprise products for our internal Operations customers.

  

This role will support creation of functional specifications, contributing to system design decisions, and managing within the software development lifecycle.

Career growth opportunities include access and exposure to technical and functional experts, business operations, and to executives and upper management. This position offers an opportunity to network with technical professionals and to build relationships within the organization being on the front lines of developing technology.

The Digital MES team at Pratt and Whitney is looking for a highly motivated, self-starter who will be excited in delivering digital solutions within our MES & Manufacturing Operations Management enterprise platform as it relates to supporting our facilities worldwide.

  

Specific focus includes process planning and manufacturing execution, as well as integration to Pratt and Whitney’s SAP ERP and other enterprise solutions.

  

Current strategic activities include supporting the strategic MES Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO) roadmap, deploying next-gen solutions, new site implementations, and integrating with new technologies for IIOT and Industry 4.0.

**Specific responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Bridging gaps between business processes and MES functionality & capabilities.

* Translating customer requirements into a solution design.

* Authoring of functional specifications.

* Troubleshooting business process against system capabilities.

* Engaging with DevOps solution management.

* Task Management with a strong follow-up discipline.

* Skills around system testing and coordination.

* Skills to support process mapping and solution design.

* Skills with navigating and operating in an Agile methodology.

* Skills with JIRA in support of DevOps management.

* Skills regarding system workflow and UI configuration.

* Meeting all budget, deliverable, and schedule targets.

* Production and end user support for MES solutions.

* Supporting integration with other enterprise solutions.

* Working with internal customers and external suppliers, business partners, to architect and build system solutions for using the latest technologies to satisfy requirements.

* Managing suppliers and partners to schedule and status resources required for solution development and implementation.

* Work on multiple projects simultaneously with regular reporting in a gated process.

* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Author and/or provide input to system functional requirements, technical design documentation and test plans.

* Work with business teams to plan and implement projects/enhancements

Ensuring compliance with RTX / PW policies & procedures.

The position is based remotely and up to 10% domestic/international travel may be required. Due to customer locations in different time zones, customer meetings can occur outside normal business work hours.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related degree and 8+ years of experience in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related field; **OR** an Advanced Degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related degree and 5+ years of experience in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related field.

Required Qualifications:

* **U.S. Citizenship is required** (required due to Government contractual requirements).

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* 3+ years’ experience with MES disciplines including, but not limited to, process planning and work order execution.

* MRO or aftermarket processes knowledge.

* Knowledge of other manufacturing solutions.

* Ability to translate business requirements to functional specifications.

* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical people, explain functional requirements to technical developers.

* Quick learner of existing system capabilities and structure.

* Prior experience in software development (JAVA, SQL, etc…) although development is not a primary responsibility.

* Detail oriented, analytical and able to trace problems.

* Strong communication skills.

* Team player with strong follow up skills and ability to craft positive relationships.

* Excellent judgment and professional business maturity.

* Strong working knowledge Microsoft Office.

* Self-starter with the ability to spot potential for process improvement.

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

**What is my role type?**

In addition to transforming the future of flight, we are also transforming how and where we work. We’ve introduced role types to help you understand how you will operate in our blended work environment.

**This role is:**

**Remote:** Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

This role will act as the operation’s customer support system. You will be responsible for, but not limited to maintaining ongoing communication with delivery teams, clients, and customers in order to address and resolve any problems or obstacles that could interfere with the timely completion of scheduled deliveries.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
  
The job functions listed below represent the essential job duties and responsibilities of the above-listed position.

* Administration of orders received at the facility for delivery. This includes prompt updating of customer portals and internal systems.

* Prompt scheduling of deliveries to the end consumer per the client specific SOP’s

* Routing process for outbound delivery trucks focusing on service, revenue per truck, driver/drive team selection and dispatch.

* Completes all shipment statuses in the appropriate operating systems and portals, collecting POD’s and communicating extra charges to customers per the established SOP’s.

* Maintains bill of lading, labeling, manifest, pick sheets, load plans and other necessary documents for the planning, loading and delivery processes.

• Communicates with sense of urgency with all parties keeping them informed of schedule or delivery issues, answering questions, responding to requests, and identifying and implementing solutions.

* Monitors delivery teams' progress through their routes and schedules – informs or makes adjustments as necessary.

* Advises delivery teams of the proper actions regarding customer, logistics or other problems which could arise and affect scheduled deliveries.

* Verifies merchandise by matching customer and sales receipt information.

* Resolves customer service issues by identifying and explaining the best solution, taking the appropriate action, and following up to ensure complete resolution.

* Prepares quality reports, load out reports, dispatch logs and tracking logs, and set up of manifests

* Manages exceptions not limited to late departures or arrivals, breakdowns, in-home service time, not at home, go backs, accidents, product or in-home damages, delivery team illness or injury.

* Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
  
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

* Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with employees, contractors, supervisors, and the general public requiring courtesy, discretion, and independent judgment.

* Excellent organizational, leadership, communication, reporting skills

* Excellent organizational, leadership, communication, reporting skills

* Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with employees, contractors, supervisors, and the general public requiring courtesy, discretion, and independent judgment.

* Detail-oriented, analytical problem-solver and ability to multi-task in a demanding environment, high-pressure, high-volume environment.

* Knowledge of relevant policies, practices and procedures and requirements / standards.

* Effective written, verbal communication skills and follow through

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  

* High school graduate or equivalent experience.
* One year customer service experience preferred

* Routing, dispatch, and warehouse experience preferred
