Position Summary:

**Department**: Telecare
  
**Shift: Day / Full Time (M-F 8-4 Hybrid)**

**Location: Olrando**

**Title: RN, Telecare Nurse Triage**

**A Brief Overview**  
  
The Registered Nurse (RN) TeleCare Nurse Triage is responsible for handling high-volume after-hours patient care concerns and coordination using Evidence-Based Practice Standards. The Telecare Nurse Triage RN practices effective problem identification, resolution, and/or escalation while addressing urgent patient clinical inquiries for Orlando Health and non-Orlando Health patients. This position includes flexible work arrangement of work from home.  
  
**What you will do**

* Under the general supervision of the TeleCare shift supervisor, the RN will be responsible for after-hours patient triaging, outbound and inbound communication through phone calls, text, video, electronic messages, or digital communication assistant assisting with nurse case management, nursing assessments, collaboration with providers, and other departments providing quality patient care in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
* Applies nursing knowledge and critical thinking skills necessary to provide developmental, cultural, and age-appropriate evidence-based care.
* Accurately assesses each patient’s condition by actively listening to callers and asking probative questions.
* Recognizes a change in patient status directing them to the appropriate care setting including, but not limited to, emergency rooms (ERs), urgent care centers, home care advice, schedule patients to their physician during office hours, or communicate information to the physician on call as needed.
* Develops, coordinates implementation of, and evaluates a plan of care for each call presented using Schmitt-Thompson protocols.
* Provides appropriate and courteous advice including plan of care and patient education to callers providing the highest level of quality care and customer service.
* Places outbound outreach follow-up calls, texts, or electronic messages to patients and caregivers as assigned for symptom management and care coordination.
* Appropriately and accurately documents initial and ongoing patient interactions, with documentation being completed immediately after the interaction.
* Acts, when designated, in “Ask a Nurse” capacity, handling routine information requests from patients, e.g., “Do I need a flu shot every year? When are you giving these shots?”
* Refills prescriptions following Orlando Health policy and provider requirements.
* Assists with scheduling patients in a same day/next day appointment spot when indicated by disposition and level of care indicated.
* Meets unit expectations for call volumes, call duration, quality, safety, and customer service.
* Maintains reasonably regular, punctual attendance consistent with Orlando Health policies, the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state, and local standards.
* Maintains compliance with all Orlando Health policies and procedures.
* Performs all other duties as assigned
* Appropriately utilizes and maintains supplied equipment; troubleshoots tech issues to ensure uninterrupted service to patients.
* Serves as a clinical resource and professional role model for other nursing staff.
* Participates in medical chart reviews and compiles data for audits and reports.
* Participates in performance improvement activities as assigned.
* Cross-trained to support remote patient monitoring (RPM), including monitoring out-of-range biometric values and coordinating appropriate clinical interventions.
* Provides operational support for enterprise pilot programs as assigned, contributing to the evaluation and integration of innovative telehealth models.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities:

Our people are passionate about what they do, the product they sell, and the customers they serve. If you're looking for an opportunity to be a part of a work family that values collaboration, innovation and dedication, we're the right company for you.  
  
**Section 1557 Non-Discrimination**  
The Office for Civil Rights (OCR) enforces Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act (Section 1557), which prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, disability, or sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, and sex characteristics), in covered health programs or activities. 42 U.S.C. 18116.  
Company is committed to diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer including veterans and people with disabilities.

Qualifications:

* Must have a BSN; Graduate of an approved school of nursing.
* Three (3) years of Advanced ED clinical experience and in area of specialty five (5) years of clinical experience when covering multiple specialties/service lines.
* Experience with Epic EMR and Schmitt-Thompson protocols preferred.
* Bilingual skills are not required but are preferred.
* Maintains current **RN license in the State of Florida.**
* Maintains **Multistate Nursing License and is obtained within first 90 days of hire.**
* Ambulatory Care Nursing Certification (AMB-BC) completion required within 36 months of hire.
* Maintains current BLS/Healthcare Provider certification.

a7b482229cfc7f074964.description:
Job Description

Momentum360 is seeking a creative, organized, and motivated **Marketing & Operations Assistant** to join our growing team!

This position is ideal for a recent college graduate or early-career professional who enjoys graphic design, photography, social media, and digital marketing while also having a passion for helping others.

At Momentum360, we work with individuals facing challenges related to behavioral health, housing instability, and access to community resources. Our goal is to connect individuals with meaningful support and opportunities to improve their overall well-being.

We're looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, create engaging content, and help keep our daily operations running smoothly.

**This is a hybrid creative and administrative role, with approximately 60% of responsibilities focused on marketing and 40% focused on operational and program support.**

Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing & Creative Content (60%)

* Design engaging email newsletters and marketing campaigns using Mailchimp.
* Create professional flyers, social media graphics, event announcements, and promotional materials using Canva.
* Capture photos and short-form videos during community events and outreach activities, following organizational privacy guidelines.
* Edit photos and videos for social media, newsletters, and marketing campaigns.
* Assist with planning, creating, and scheduling social media content.
* Help develop creative strategies to increase community awareness and engagement.
* Maintain consistent branding across social media, email communications, and printed materials.
* Collaborate with leadership to promote organizational programs, partnerships, and events.

Operations & Program Support (40%)

* Assist with administrative documentation, progress note preparation, and organization of program records under appropriate supervision.
* Support data entry, spreadsheets, member tracking, and program reporting.
* Help coordinate community outreach events, meetings, and special projects.
* Assist with member communications and connecting individuals to available community resources.
* Maintain organized and accurate electronic records.
* Provide general administrative support to case managers and leadership.
* Assist with improving internal systems and day-to-day operational efficiency.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow organizational policies regarding sensitive member information.

Qualifications

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Sociology, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Human services-related education is strongly preferred.
* Strong interest in graphic design, digital content creation, and marketing.
* Basic photography and photo/video editing abilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable learning new technology and software platforms.
* Passion for supporting underserved individuals and communities.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team.

**Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)**

* Experience using Canva, Mailchimp, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.
* Experience creating social media content or managing social media accounts.
* Familiarity with photography, video editing, or digital marketing.
* Previous nonprofit, behavioral health, or human services experience.
* Experience with case management documentation or electronic health records.
* Experience planning or assisting with community events.

**Recent graduates are encouraged to apply!** Professional experience is not required if you can demonstrate creativity, strong organizational skills, and a willingness to learn.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?

At Momentum360, you won't be limited to one department or spend every day performing the same tasks.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* **Build your creative portfolio** through real marketing campaigns, photography, and design projects.
* **Gain nonprofit and human services experience** while supporting meaningful community programs.
* **Work directly with leadership** and contribute ideas that help shape the organization's growth.
* **Develop transferable professional skills** in marketing, administration, operations, and community outreach.
* **Make a meaningful impact** by helping connect individuals with programs, services, and resources.

**GRADE: 29E**

**CONTEXT OF THE JOB:**

The University of Delaware’s business school, the Alfred Lerner College of Business and Economics, is a hub for innovation, business and economics research and career success. With hands-on experiences and a technology-driven curriculum, Lerner equips students to navigate the evolving business world and drive change worldwide.
  
  
Under the general supervision of the Senior Assistant Dean and the Director of Lerner Career Services, the Administrative Specialist oversees the administrative and fiscal operations supporting Lerner Undergraduate Advising, Lerner Career Services, and undergraduate recruitment activities. The Administrative Specialist monitors departmental budgets and expenditures; coordinates administrative processes, events, and front-desk operations; prepares enrollment and other administrative reports; manages departmental data and reporting systems; supervises support staff and student employees; coordinates web and communications activities; and serves as a liaison between the unit and the Lerner College Business Office and other University offices. The position is responsible for applying and interpreting University policies and procedures, assisting with policy development, analyzing administrative practices, and recommending improvements to enhance operational effectiveness and service delivery.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the Lerner Undergraduate Advising and Lerner Career Services units and support undergraduate recruitment activities. Process requisitions, invoices, purchasing transactions, and other financial documents, including preparing and administering departmental purpose codes and budgets.
* Administer departmental purchasing card transactions.
* Monitor and review departmental expenditures for appropriate funding, reporting, and policy compliance.
* Ensure the accuracy and availability of funding and compliance with standard accounting and audit procedures.
* Ensure the smooth and effective operation of the unit’s administrative office and front-desk reception services.
* Assist the Senior Assistant Dean with confidential correspondence and sensitive student matters, including issues related to medical leaves, dismissals, and suspensions. Handle confidential information in accordance with university policies and applicable privacy requirements.
* Supervise non-exempt support staff, miscellaneous workers, graduate students, and student employees; hire, motivate, develop, direct, and assign work; monitor workload and productivity; evaluate performance; provide staff training and development; provide assistance in analyzing and resolving complex issues.
* Plan, coordinate, and conduct projects requiring judgment in the independent evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard techniques.
* Work closely with the College events management team to plan and coordinate major undergraduate events. Coordinate First-Year Student Welcome Back, Honors Day, and undergraduate Convocation ceremonies. Assist with program production, logistics, and event-related communications. Provide occasional weekend support for Convocation, recruiting events, and other major University activities.
* Work with Lerner Marketing/Communication team to support mass communications to students and prospective students.
* Provide information, resolve problems, complete surveys, and prepare reports in support of unit operations. Implement administrative policies and procedures established by the Senior Assistant Dean and Director and recommend revisions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with university policies and procedures.
* Order, maintain, and inventory office supplies and equipment.
* Provide a high level of customer service to students, faculty, staff, alumni, prospective students and families, and employers both in person and by telephone.
* Maintain exempt and non-exempt vacation and sick leave records and timesheets for student workers and miscellaneous wage employees.
* Review and process student requests for documented excused absences.

**About Us**

At Ovation Law Firm, we’re more than just attorneys — we’re a source of hope and justice for consumers and injury victims. Our firm is dedicated to turning legal challenges into life-changing victories worldwide. We handle Lemon Law and Personal Injury cases with relentless commitment, standing up for our clients when it matters most.

We pride ourselves on being relentless advocates who never back down, ensuring that our clients' rights are fiercely protected. If you are passionate about making a meaningful difference and eager to contribute to our unwavering pursuit of justice, we invite you to join our dynamic team.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Settlement Coordinator to join our remote team and support our mission of achieving meaningful outcomes for clients nationwide.

**About the Role**

  

The Settlement Coordinator moves lemon law cases from demand to funded settlement. You track every settlement, keep manufacturers and clients on schedule, and make sure settlement paperwork, vehicle surrenders and payments close cleanly.

We represent consumers in automotive lemon law claims against manufacturers nationwide. You will work closely with attorneys, case managers and manufacturer counsel on a high volume of active files.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Calculate repurchase and cash-and-keep figures, including incidental damages, offsets for use, negative equity and payoff amounts.
* Track every settlement, offer and counter-offer, and flag responses that fall below authorized ranges to the assigned attorney.
* Serve as day-to-day contact with manufacturer representatives and defense counsel on open settlements.
* Follow up on outstanding checks, vehicle surrenders, release drafts and funding timelines, and escalate files that stall past firm deadlines.
* Coordinate vehicle surrender logistics, including inspection dates, title transfer, lienholder payoff and payment of attorney's fees.
* Explain offers, settlement terms and next steps to clients in plain language.
* Obtain signed releases, settlement agreements, odometer statements and other required documents.
* Keep clients updated on surrender scheduling and payment status.
* Review release agreements for accuracy against the agreed terms before sending for signature.
* Track settlement checks and attorney fee payments through receipt and disbursement.
* Confirm lien and loan payoffs are completed and documented.
* Keep case management records current for every settlement milestone.

  

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years in a law firm, claims, or settlement role, preferably in consumer or plaintiff-side litigation.
* Experience reading and summarizing financial documents such as purchase contracts, lease agreements and loan payoff statements.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas for damages and offset calculations.
* Experience with a case management system (e.g., Filevine, Clio).
* Clear, professional written communication with clients and opposing counsel.
* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and quality in all tasks and deliverables.

  

**What We Offer**

  

* Earn $22-24/hour: Pay based on your skills and experience for a full-time, 40-hour workweek.
* Boost Your Income: Enjoy performance-based bonuses.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance benefits.
* 7 Paid time off (PTO) days plus 7 paid holidays.
* Opportunity to directly influence the growth and success of a rapidly expanding law firm.
* Long-term growth opportunities within a fast-growing organization.

  

**Work Location**

This is a fully remote position open only to candidates residing in Florida.

**How to Apply**

  

Applying takes two short steps:

  

* Submit your application
* Complete our Culture Index survey (about 10 minutes): https://go.cultureindex.com/p/wV7Ib6RQQH2

*The survey is a short questionnaire about how you naturally like to work. There are no right or wrong answers, and we look at it alongside your experience, not instead of it. Please use the same name and email address on the survey that you use on this application so we can match them up.*

5e0103a3e4897e9b05ad.description:
Job Description

**Part -Time Rolex Concierge – Job Description**

**Location: Christiana Mall, Delaware**

**Reports To:** Store Management

  

**Position:** Rolex Concierge

**Department:** Retail Rolex

**About Us:**

The 1916 Company is a premier luxury watch and fine jewelry retailer with showrooms and boutiques across the US, Collector's Lounges in major domestic and international markets, and four international offices - with 25 locations in total. We are committed to delivering exceptional client experiences and building teams of extraordinary individuals who share our passion for excellence and the world's finest timepieces and jewelry.

**Job Summary:**

The Concierge serves as the first point of contact for clients, setting the tone for an exceptional luxury shopping experience with The 1916 Company. This individual is responsible for creating a warm and welcoming environment, assisting with greeting and meeting the needs of clients, and providing seamless service throughout their visit. The Concierge will anticipate client expectations, coordinate personalized experiences, and support the sales team in delivering an elevated level of hospitality and exclusivity.

**Objectives:**

The objective of the Concierge is to deliver exceptional client support and foster lasting relationships. This role plays a critical part in enhancing overall customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Client Experience & Hospitality***

* Greeting clients warmly, offering personalized service from the moment they enter the store.
* Assisting in the management of foot traffic flow and matching clients with available advisors.
* Provide hospitality, including offering refreshments and ensuring client comfort.
* Maintain a polished, professional presence that reflects the store’s luxury standards.
* Assist in coordinating in-store experiences, private appointments, special deliveries, and special events.

***Client Support & Assistance***

* Facilitate smooth transitions between different touchpoints of the client’s journey in-store.
* Attending to the phone, answering calls, fielding questions, taking messages, and seeing that calls and messages are directed to the appropriate person.
* Provide basic product knowledge and brand information, directing inquiries to appropriate Client Advisors.
* Provide support in service, welcoming clients, taking information (when needed), offering pickups, and cleaning (given proper training).
* Assist with store tours and navigation, ensuring clients receive undivided attention and personalized service.
* Support in managing appointments, reservations, and client requests efficiently.

***Personalized Service & Relationship Building***

* Learn and remember Client IQ and preferences to contribute to a more tailored experience.
* Handle special client requests, such as securing a private viewing area or arranging gift wrapping and delivery services.

***Store Operations & Support***

* Maintain the appearance of the Rolex space, ensuring it is immaculate, inviting, and meets the Swiss Eye standards.
* Coordinate with the leadership and back-office teams to enhance client experience.
* Assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, registry updates, and appointment follow-up when needed.
* Restock refrigerators and other hospitality supplies throughout the store.
* Check appearance of spaces, cleaning up flowers, outside of cases, drink and hospitality areas, and giving attention to any other areas as needed.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** Minimum 2-3 years in luxury retail, hospitality, or a client-facing role.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a polished and professional demeanor.
* **Client-Centric Mindset:** Passion for delivering personalized service and creating memorable experiences.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to anticipate and address client needs with discretion and efficiency.
* **Organization & Multitasking:** Strong ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service.
* **Technology:** Proficiency in CRM systems, appointment scheduling tools, and basic office software.
* **Luxury Aesthetic:** Understanding of luxury brand culture, etiquette, and service expectations.

  

**Core Competencies**

* **Hospitality & Warmth:** Ability to make every client feel valued and welcome.
* **Attention to Detail:** Ensuring every aspect of the store environment and client experience is flawless.
* **Discretion & Professionalism:** Handling VIP and high-profile clients with the utmost confidentiality and care.
* **Team Collaboration:** Working seamlessly with Client Advisors, Managers, and support teams.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to adjust to dynamic client needs and in-store experiences.

**Performance Metrics**

* Client satisfaction, reviews, and mystery shop scores.
* Efficiency in managing appointments and store flow.
* Contribution to enhanced client relationships and repeat visits.
* Coordination and execution of special client experiences.

  

*The Concierge is an integral part of the luxury retail experience, ensuring each client interaction is seamless, elegant, and memorable. By embodying hospitality, discretion, and service excellence, this role enhances the prestige of the store and fosters deep client relationships.*

**POSITION TITLE:** Project Management Assistant

**LOCATION:** Remote

**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a Public Trust

  

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  

At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low-code/no-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.

In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  

**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**

  

Seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Project Management Assistant to provide administrative and coordination support to two or more Project Managers across APV's federal contracts. This role keeps project operations running smoothly — managing schedules, meetings, documentation, status reporting, and deliverable tracking — so Project Managers can stay focused on client delivery and team leadership. The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable balancing competing priorities, and thrives in a fast-paced federal contracting environment.

  

**DUTIES**

  

* Provide day-to-day administrative support Project Managers, balancing competing priorities and deadlines across multiple contracts.
* Manage Project calendars; schedule internal and client meetings, coordinate attendees, and set up virtual or in-person meeting logistics.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes and action items, and distribute finalized notes after management review.
* Coordinate daily stand-ups and weekly internal status meetings, and gather task status from project team members.
* Compile weekly status reports, briefing materials, and supporting data to prepare Project Managers for client status meetings.
* Track contract deliverables, milestones, and due dates; send reminders and follow up with team members to support on-time, accountable delivery.
* Maintain project schedules, action item logs, risk and issue logs, and trackers using tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, SharePoint, or Smartsheet.
* Organize and maintain project files, document libraries, and version control in SharePoint/Teams in line with contract and APV records requirements.
* Format, proofread, and quality-check deliverables, reports, presentations, and correspondence before submission.
* Support onboarding logistics for new project team members, including system access requests, badging, and required client training, in partnership with HR and Operations.
* Assist with timesheet reminders, labor-hour tracking, invoice support data, and monthly status report preparation.
* Serve as a point of contact for routine project inquiries from team members and client staff, routing issues to the appropriate Project Manager.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

**EDUCATION**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Communications, or a related field preferred. An Associate's degree combined with relevant experience, or equivalent relevant experience, may be considered.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Minimum 2 years of experience providing administrative, project coordination, or program support, preferably in a government contracting or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated ability to support multiple managers and projects at the same time while meeting deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including meeting minutes, status reports, and professional correspondence with clients.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint).
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential information.

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or active progress toward one.
* Experience supporting federal contracts (e.g., CMS, DHS, or other civilian agencies), including familiarity with contract deliverables and monthly status reporting.
* Experience with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar project management tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ceremonies and terminology.

  

**ABOUT APV**

  

APV is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or marital status.

abd0075df5f9e29de1eb.description:
**ESL Teacher for Adult Learners — Virtual, Remote**

*Teach motivated adult Russian-speaking professionals in the U.S. to build real-world English fluency.*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You’ll teach live online 1:1, 1:2 and group English lessons via Zoom using professionally designed, ready-to-teach materials. Students are adult native Russian speakers living in the USA — motivated, driven, and enrolled in a structured year-long fluency program.

**ABOUT ME**

I’m an ESL educator and former school teacher with a Master’s degree in Curriculum & Instruction and 4 years of experience in American public schools as a reading specialist and special education coordinator. I created Fluency Gym — a cohort-based adult English fluency program — initially as a small side project. It’s grown beyond what I can teach alone, and I’m looking for the right person to grow with me.

**WHY THIS POSITION IS OPEN**

Demand for Fluency Gym has grown faster than my capacity. I need a skilled, reliable teacher to take on cohorts so students don’t have to wait. You’ll be stepping into a program that already works — your job is to deliver it well.

**WHAT I OFFER**

* Flexible scheduling — you choose the hours that work for you
* Complete, professionally prepared lesson materials — no lesson planning from scratch required
* Hands-on onboarding and ongoing training
* Regular feedback delivered in a supportive, collaborative way
* A clear, structured program to teach — no guesswork

**LONG-TERM GROWTH**

This is not just a teaching gig — it’s the start of something bigger. As Fluency Gym grows, I’m looking for my first teacher to grow with it — taking on more cohorts, eventually moving into a lead teacher or supervisor role, and helping onboard and mentor new teachers. If you’re someone who wants to build something meaningful, not just teach classes, this is for you.

**COMPENSATION**

Earn **$18-22/hr** based on performance. Base pay is guaranteed, with additional performance bonuses on top. No lesson planning means your paid hours are focused on what matters: teaching and supporting your students.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Deliver live 1:1, 1:2 and group lessons via Zoom following provided lesson materials
* Create a warm, engaging, and productive classroom environment
* Manage group dynamics to ensure balanced participation (not dominated by a few students)
* Track student attendance and progress
* Provide students with clear, encouraging, and actionable feedback on their language use and progress
* Communicate with me regularly about student performance and group dynamics
* Implement feedback from lesson observations

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Students show measurable improvement in fluency and confidence
* Students complete the program and re-enroll or refer others
* Lessons run smoothly and on schedule with high engagement
* You grow as a teacher through consistent feedback and professional development

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Required**

* Excellent English language skills
* Zoom and Google Drive proficiency
* Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional teaching environment
* Experience teaching adults (1+ years)
* Online teaching experience (1+ years)

**Preferred**

* Teaching groups online (4+ students)
* TEFL/TESOL certificate
* Background in ESL, linguistics, or education
* Familiarity with Russian-speaking culture

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

You’re genuinely excited about your students’ progress. You’re growth-minded — you actively seek feedback, take it seriously, and implement it. You’re organized, show up on time, and communicate proactively. You understand that teaching from provided materials is a skill in itself and you bring your own energy and warmth to every lesson.

Ideally, you’re thinking long-term: you want to grow inside a program. You’re interested in eventually taking on more responsibility — mentoring other teachers, maintaining quality standards, and being part of building something.

**THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU…**

* Are not comfortable teaching diverse groups, including both Russian and Ukrainian students
* Prefer to design your own curriculum and resist working from prepared materials
* See feedback as criticism rather than professional development
* Are looking for a short-term contract with no interest in growing with the program

**TO APPLY**

**Please include the following in your application:**

* A short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and briefly explaining how you would handle a quiet, unresponsive group
* Your available hours (days and time zones)

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

* Alert the clinical team via Venga as soon as patients arrive or if any changes to the schedule

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

  

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

* About the Team & Role

  + Headway is looking for an experienced Vendor Operations Lead to own our patient-facing BPO partnerships and drive results. The person in this role will help scale the programs that connect people with mental health care as Headway grows. Our Customer Experience team is the tip of the spear that will make affordable mental health care a reality for millions, and you will be there to shape the experience patients have when they first reach out.

In this position, you will bring a bias for action to a fast-moving, high-volume operation. You'll manage day-to-day partner performance, hold our BPO partners to clear standards, and be the main point of contact between the BPO and our internal teams. You'll work closely with partner leadership to improve conversion, so more patients who reach out leave with an appointment, while keeping quality and service strong.

The person in this role will have the opportunity to build the systems, processes and structure a fast-growing program needs. You'll play a pivotal role in strengthening the foundation behind key metrics like conversion, quality, responsiveness and patient satisfaction.

* You Will

  + Own day-to-day BPO partner performance, including tracking results against goals and leading improvement initiatives.
  + Serve as the main point of contact between our BPO partners and internal teams, keeping priorities and expectations aligned.
  + Meet regularly with BPO leadership to address ongoing challenges and keep performance moving toward goal.
  + Use data to spot trends, find root causes, and turn insights into clear action plans.
  + Partner with cross-functional teams to make sure BPO partners have what they need to succeed.
  + Build and improve the processes and structure that let our programs scale.
  + Contribute to the short, medium and long-term strategy for Headway's BPO operations.
* You’d be a great fit if…

  + You've worked in contact center or CX operations for 4+ years and have a strong understanding of its metrics, processes and tools.
  + You have experience managing BPO or outsourced teams, and you know how to build a respectful partnership while holding partners accountable for results.
  + You're analytically minded and use data to understand why performance changed and what to do about it.
  + You have a track record of improving operations and building structure where none existed.
  + You're operationally excellent and unflappable in a fast-moving environment.
  + You seek an environment that fosters growth through open feedback and high autonomy.
  + You're motivated by the opportunity to make an impact on one of our generation's defining problems: making mental health care accessible and affordable.
  + Bonus: you've managed BPO teams in a sales, conversion or retention capacity.

77cf53411ea0971fc721.title: Billing Specialist (Temporary)
77cf53411ea0971fc721.description:
**Position Summary**

The Temporary Billing Specialist supports Tres Health’s billing operations, including billing configuration migration, data validation, renewal processing, and quality assurance. This role is responsible for reviewing and reconciling billing data, updating configurations within internal systems, creating and updating renewal rates, preparing renewal packets, and ensuring billing and renewal information is accurate, complete, and processed in accordance with established procedures.

The Billing Specialist works across multiple systems and portals to maintain accurate records, identify and resolve discrepancies, and support timely completion of billing and renewal activities. The ideal candidate has strong Excel skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to learn internal systems quickly, work independently, and manage high-volume processing workloads while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Review, audit, and reconcile existing billing configuration data maintained in Excel spreadsheets and legacy systems to support accurate migration into internal portals.
* Enter, edit, and update group billing configurations within designated systems and portals, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Validate billing configuration information and submit configurations for approval in accordance with established procedures.
* Perform quality assurance reviews of billing configurations to identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential processing errors.
* Review and approve billing configurations within internal portals when authorized and in accordance with established approval procedures.
* Audit existing billing configurations to identify, investigate, and correct data inconsistencies and configuration discrepancies.
* Create and update renewal rates and related billing information in accordance with established requirements.
* Prepare, review, and submit renewal packets, ensuring required documentation and supporting information are accurate and complete.
* Validate renewal data, rates, calculations, documentation, and system entries before submission and final processing.
* Perform quality assurance reviews of renewal rates, renewal packets, billing configurations, and related submissions to identify and resolve errors.
* Update premium builders and billing configurations as part of the renewal process, ensuring system information aligns with applicable renewal requirements.
* Research and troubleshoot data inconsistencies, calculation discrepancies, and configuration issues, escalating complex or unresolved matters as appropriate.
* Maintain accurate records of completed work, validation activities, identified discrepancies, and corrective actions.
* Manage assigned workloads and competing priorities to meet production targets, quality standards, and time-sensitive billing and renewal deadlines.
* Follow established workflows, documentation standards, approval requirements, and internal controls, maintaining appropriate separation between processing, quality assurance, and approval responsibilities.
* Identify recurring errors and opportunities to improve data accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational workflows.
* Collaborate with team members and internal stakeholders to resolve exceptions and support consistent execution of billing and renewal processes.
* Other tasks as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Insurance, or a related field preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in billing operations, insurance operations, benefits administration, renewals, data entry, or a related field preferred.
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to review, reconcile, compare, and validate large datasets.
* Experience entering, maintaining, and validating data across multiple business systems, portals, or administrative platforms.
* Working knowledge of billing configurations, billing structures, premium calculations, or related insurance and benefits administration processes preferred.
* Familiarity with rate development, renewal processing, renewal documentation, and submission workflows preferred.
* Experience performing quality assurance reviews, identifying discrepancies, and validating data accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data inconsistencies and determine appropriate corrective actions.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and completeness.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage high-volume processing workloads while meeting deadlines.
* Ability to learn new systems, internal processes, and configuration requirements quickly.
* Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with remote team members.
* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and handle confidential business, customer, financial, and benefits-related information appropriately.
* Insurance, employee benefits, healthcare billing, or benefits administration experience preferred.
* Experience with billing system migrations, premium builder configuration, rate calculations, or renewal platforms preferred.

**Work Schedule & Remote Work**

Temporary, remote position aligned with U.S. business hours. Flexibility may be required to support billing deadlines, renewal processing, migration milestones, high-volume processing periods, and other time-sensitive operational needs. The anticipated duration of the temporary assignment and expected weekly hours will be communicated separately.

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Dedicated home office with reliable, high-speed internet.
* Secure workspace aligned with applicable company security and privacy requirements, including secure Wi-Fi and screen privacy.
* Ability to complete billing, data migration, renewal processing, and quality assurance activities effectively in a fully remote environment.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and securely handle customer, financial, benefits, and other sensitive information.
* Ability to use Microsoft Excel, internal billing and renewal portals, document management systems, video conferencing tools, and other standard remote work technology.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while maintaining communication with the manager and team regarding progress, discrepancies, and potential delays.

**Security, Privacy & Compliance**

This position requires adherence to Tres Health’s security and privacy policies and applicable requirements for safeguarding confidential business, customer, financial, and benefits-related information. The employee must complete required security training, follow access management protocols, use approved systems and tools, and comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.

The employee is expected to access and modify billing configurations and renewal information only within the scope of assigned responsibilities and authorized permissions. All data changes, quality assurance activities, and approvals must follow established procedures and internal controls.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
* Ability to communicate effectively through video, phone, and written platforms.
* Ability to effectively use computers, spreadsheets, billing and renewal systems, and other standard remote work technology.
* Visual and auditory capabilities suitable for remote work.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds.

Tres Health is committed to ADA compliance and will provide reasonable accommodations to individuals as needed.

**Employment Status**

This is a temporary employment position. The anticipated assignment duration, schedule, and applicable employment terms will be communicated separately. Employment is governed by applicable law and the terms of the employee’s employment arrangement.

**EEO & Reasonable Accommodation**

Tres Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected category. Tres Health provides reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. This description is not intended to list all duties or qualifications and may be updated at any time.

As a Medical Billing Specialist on our Client Access team, you’ll play an important role in that process by verifying insurance benefits, identifying coverage requirements or barriers, and helping ensure accurate information is available before services begin. **Position:** Sales-Operations Coordinator  
**Reports to:** Associate Manager, Sales-Operations  
**Department:** High School Outbound  
**Location:** US Remote (and Canada when applicable)

**Who we are:**

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

**Why work with us:**

* + **You will change the world.** CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  + **You will receive a competitive total rewards package.** CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
    - Paid time off and Parental leave
    - Gym Reimbursement Program
    - Employee Assistance Program
    - Short-term & Long-term Disability
    - 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
    - CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
    - 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
    - Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
    - Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts (medical and dependent)
    - Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
* **You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals.** CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study-abroad locations, with facilities and staff in 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year. Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

**Who you are:**

The Sales Operations Coordinator serves as the operational systems and process expert for the Global Navigator High School Study Abroad team. This role owns and coordinates key operational workflows, including application management, enrollment processes, student systems, billing support, learning platforms, reporting, and process documentation. Working closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Information Technology, and cross-functional teams, the Coordinator ensures accurate execution of operational processes, provides timely support on customer and Sales inquiries, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency through systems and process improvements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically proficient, detail-oriented, and enjoys solving problems through process improvement and technology.

**What you’ll do:**

* Application & Systems Management: Maintain and improve student application and enrollment systems, including testing updates, troubleshooting issues, managing system configurations, and supporting ongoing platform enhancements. Serve as the primary operational resource for Sales and internal teams regarding application workflows, system functionality, and process-related questions.
* Operational Process Coordination: Own and coordinate operational workflows that support the student lifecycle, including application processes, enrollment steps, language testing, travel insurance, scholarship administration, and other department initiatives. Provide guidance to Sales and internal teams on process requirements, timelines, and next steps while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Learning Management & Student Resources: Maintain student Pre-Departure courses and learning content within Canvas; support updates, testing, and continuous improvements to online learning resources and enrollment processes; collaborate with the Study Abroad Advisors to ensure accurate and up to date content.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management: Develop, maintain, and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, user guides, and operational documentation to support consistent execution across the Global Navigator High School Study Abroad team. Partner with subject matter experts, including Study Abroad Advisors, to ensure documentation accurately reflects program requirements and operational processes.

* Reporting & Data Management: Maintain operational data, perform audits, generate reports, and support data integrity across department systems to inform decision-making and ensure accurate student records.
* Technical Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary operational support resource for Sales and internal stakeholders regarding applications, enrollment processes, billing inquiries, financial statements, student systems, and department platforms. Collaborate with IT and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and ensure effective operational workflows.
* Communication & Stakeholder Support: Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Sales and internal stakeholders regarding application status, enrollment processes, billing inquiries, financial statements, system-related questions, and administrative requirements. Communicate process updates, deadlines, and workflow expectations to ensure accurate and consistent execution across teams. Partner with Study Abroad Advisors and other cross-functional teams to align operational communications with program requirements and customer expectations.
* Process Improvement & Technology Optimization: Analyze workflows, identify operational challenges, test system enhancements, and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and the overall user experience.
* Operational Support: Participate in annual in-person trainings and ongoing professional development; provide operational support during travel weekends in the summer and peak program periods, including occasional evening, weekend, and travel responsibilities as needed; perform other duties as assigned.

**What you’ll bring:**

The ideal candidate will possess:

* Bachelor's degree
* Two or more years of professional experience in operations, project coordination, systems administration, customer support, or a related field.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn, troubleshoot, and optimize multiple software platforms and systems.
* Experience working with CRM, application management, learning management, database, or project management systems; Salesforce and Canvas experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with formulas, large datasets, reporting, and data analysis; experience with automation or advanced reporting tools is preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement practical, scalable improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing SOPs, training materials, and process documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

***Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background, reference, education, and employment check will be conducted as a condition of employment.***

97db373b5d922b8ee5bb.title: Pharmacy Sales Administrator
97db373b5d922b8ee5bb.description:
Role Summary

The Pharmacy Sales Administrator supports Medsense pharmacy partners throughout the sales, onboarding, implementation, and ongoing account management process. This role helps ensure each pharmacy is onboarded efficiently, successfully implements Medsense programs, and maximizes call completion, revenue generation, and patient engagement.

Serving as a primary point of contact for pharmacy partners, this person builds strong relationships with pharmacists, coordinates new program rollouts, identifies opportunities for improvement, and communicates partner feedback to internal teams. The role works closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and Marketing to support pharmacy success and grow the Medsense network.

This is a fully remote position, with most pharmacy engagement conducted by phone and video rather than in-person visits. Travel is expected to be less than 5%. The role reports to both the Sales and Operations teams.

Core ResponsibilitiesAccount Management

* Maintain regular communication with pharmacy partners, engaging each account monthly during the initial 90-day onboarding phase and transitioning to quarterly engagement thereafter.
* Review account performance metrics, including calls made, call completion rates, and revenue generated.
* Partner with pharmacies to identify opportunities to improve performance, increase program participation, and maximize revenue.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for pharmacy partners, providing responsive, empathetic, and solutions-oriented support.
* Gather feedback from pharmacy partners regarding the Medsense platform, identifying successful features, areas for improvement, and opportunities for new services.
* Communicate pharmacy feedback and recommendations to the appropriate internal teams.

Implementation and Ongoing Engagement

* Support the Sales team during the later stages of the sales process, helping move prospective pharmacy partners from agreement through implementation.
* Coordinate onboarding activities and support pharmacies through implementation and go-live.
* Provide ongoing guidance and support to pharmacy partners following implementation.
* Assist pharmacies with training, staffing coordination, and operational needs related to new clinical programs.
* Monitor implementation progress, identify potential roadblocks, and help ensure a smooth transition into ongoing account management.

Account Growth and Program Development

* Educate pharmacy partners on new Medsense clinical programs and identify opportunities to introduce programs that align with their needs.
* Help pharmacies identify potential patients who may benefit from available clinical programs.
* Encourage adoption of new programs and support pharmacies in maximizing participation and results.
* Gather recommendations from pharmacy partners regarding new services and opportunities for Medsense.
* Build strong partner relationships that generate referrals and support continued growth of the pharmacy network.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen engagement, improve performance, and expand existing accounts.

Marketing Support

* Partner with the Marketing team on pharmacy-facing initiatives, including newsletters, customer spotlights, videos, and clinical content.
* Help coordinate and communicate marketing initiatives to pharmacy partners.
* Guide pharmacy partners through the rollout of in-store marketing strategies and promotional materials.
* Gather feedback on marketing initiatives and identify opportunities to improve awareness, engagement, and program adoption.

Sales and Administrative Support

* Support the Sales team with pharmacy data collection, IVR setup, contract follow-up, redline coordination, and other administrative activities.
* Help keep sales and implementation workflows organized, accurate, and moving forward.
* Maintain clear documentation of account activity, implementation progress, and partner communications.
* Document recurring sales-support processes and workflows to enable an eventual transition of administrative responsibilities to a coordinator.
* Collaborate with Sales and Operations to improve processes, increase efficiency, and support the growing pharmacy network.

What Success Looks LikeAreaMeasure of SuccessAccount EngagementEvery pharmacy partner is reviewed according to the established cadence: monthly during the initial 90 days, then quarterly.Account PerformanceCall completion rates and revenue per pharmacy trend upward.ImplementationPharmacies move efficiently from contract signing to go-live.Program GrowthExisting pharmacy partners adopt new clinical programs and increase participation.Network GrowthPharmacy partners provide referrals that result in new signed accounts.Product FeedbackPharmacy feedback is documented, organized, and shared with the Product team.Marketing SupportPharmacy partners receive support with marketing initiatives and in-store program rollouts.Process ImprovementSales-support workflows are documented and prepared for handoff to a coordinator.Ideal Background

* **Pharmacy experience is required.** Candidates must have a strong understanding of pharmacy operations and the ability to communicate effectively with pharmacists and pharmacy teams.
* Experience in account management, customer service, sales administration, or pharmacy relationship management is strongly preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple accounts, implementations, and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable reviewing account metrics, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping pharmacy partners increase program engagement and performance.
* Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through skills, with a customer-focused and empathetic approach.
* Ability to build trusted relationships remotely through phone and video communication.
* Comfortable supporting new program rollouts, coordinating implementation activities, and documenting processes for future handoff.
* Adaptable and resourceful, with the ability to navigate changing priorities and resolve issues while maintaining a positive partner experience.

Position Details

* **Position Title:** Pharmacy Sales Administrator
* **Work Arrangement:** Fully remote
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Central Time

fbd7d00b3483fb3fc2ff.title: Automation Ops Specialist
fbd7d00b3483fb3fc2ff.description:
Our Mission:

**Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.**

Overview:

**How you can make a difference**

The Support Operations Specialist, AI Agent Management supports the buildout and ongoing operation of Member Services Automated Operations. This hands-on individual contributor role sits at the intersection of conversation design, support automation, and Member Services operations. The role shapes how HealthEquity’s AI support agents communicate with members, structure interactions, detect intent, route issues, and hand off to human support while also helping build the operational workflows, integrations, guardrails, and monitoring needed for AI agents to safely resolve issues end-to-end. The role executes on the AI support optimization roadmap by configuring agent behaviors, improving prompts and knowledge, testing workflows, identifying automation opportunities, documenting standards, and tracking production performance against containment, resolution, escalation, quality, and member experience outcomes.

**Reporting Structure and Work Setting**

* Reports to the Director, Automated Member Support Operations.
* Partners with Member Services leaders, Human Support Operations, Strategic Programs, Product, Engineering, Digital Experience, Operations Excellence, Workforce / Operational Analytics, Quality, Training, Compliance, and other support partners.
* Role may be performed remotely or in a hybrid setting based on business needs and company policy.

**What you’ll be doing**

**AI Agent Operations and Optimization**

* Monitor deployed Member Services AI support experiences in production using containment, automation rate, resolution rate, escalation patterns, transfer accuracy, repeat contact impact, sentiment, quality outcomes, and member experience trends.
* Design, tune, and test conversation flows, triage logic, prompts, knowledge content, detection attributes, guidance rules, tone, structure, and handoff behaviors across high-volume and high-impact support use cases.
* Create and maintain AI optimization backlogs, including defect tracking, improvement hypotheses, testing notes, release documentation, and expected business impact.
* Configure AI agent behaviors and workflow logic so automated experiences can safely take action, route cases, collect required context, surface relevant account or issue details, and escalate exceptions to the right human support path.
* Analyze conversational data, frontline feedback, escalations, and support outcomes to identify opportunities to improve accuracy, resolution quality, and efficiency.
* Partner with leaders and technical teams to prioritize improvements that increase automation effectiveness while maintaining compliance, quality, and member trust.

**Low/No-Code Automation and Operational Tooling**

* Identify manual workflows, operational pain points, and teammate experience opportunities where AI agent action-taking, workflow automation, or lightweight tooling can improve speed, accuracy, consistency, or productivity.
* Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and support low/no-code tools, internal automations, AI agent workflows, and operational aids for Member Services users.
* Document build standards, user instructions, support processes, access requirements, and operational controls for tools owned or maintained by Automated Operations.
* Support integrations between AI support experiences and approved internal systems or vendor platforms so agents can retrieve information, trigger defined actions, support status awareness, and reduce manual handling when appropriate.
* Design guardrails, validation logic, exception handling, and escalation paths for automated workflows that affect member outcomes, account servicing, or operational decisioning.
* Support pilots and launches of automation solutions, including training, feedback collection, adoption tracking, and post-launch improvement planning.
* Maintain awareness of enterprise technology standards, security requirements, data handling expectations, and change management practices.

**Automated Operations Governance and Quality**

* Follow governance practices for testing, documentation, user acceptance, safe execution, release readiness, defect management, auditability, exception handling, and ongoing production support.
* Participate in regular inspection rhythms for AI agent performance, automation outcomes, workflow reliability, incident trends, and operational risk areas.
* Escalate issues requiring Product, Engineering, Compliance, Privacy, Security, or operational leadership review.
* Translate operational requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, test cases, and prioritized improvement work.
* Help ensure AI and automation experiences are understandable, measurable, supportable, and aligned with Member Services operating expectations.

**Capability Development and Knowledge Sharing**

* Contribute to the creation of repeatable Automated Operations playbooks, templates, standards, and training materials.
* Share practical knowledge with Member Services team members learning low/no-code development, AI agent optimization, automation testing, and operational governance.

* Support short-term assignments, pilots, and capability-building efforts that convert Member Services domain expertise into scalable automated operations capacity.
* Stay current on AI support technology, internal tools, workflow automation capabilities, and practical use cases relevant to Member Services.

**What you will need to be successful**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations Management, Computer Science, or related discipline preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 3+ years of experience in support operations, customer operations, automated operations, support engineering, chatbot / AI agent configuration, digital support, workflow automation, quality, training, process improvement, or related functions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze operational problems, document workflows, test solutions, and drive practical improvements.
* Hands-on experience configuring AI agents, chatbots, automation tools, support workflows, or low/no-code tooling required; experience with platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce, contact center AI platforms, workflow builders, or similar tools preferred.
* Experience designing conversation flows, prompts, tone, structure, intent detection, categorization logic, or AI-to-human handoff experiences preferred.
* Experience working with integrations, APIs, workflow builders, system configuration, or technical implementation partners strongly preferred.
* Experience working in regulated, compliance-focused, or quality-sensitive support environments preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Ability to translate frontline operational knowledge into AI agent improvement opportunities, automation requirements, and testable solutions.
* Fluent using low/no-code development tools, prompt/workflow configuration, reporting tools, and operational systems.
* Thinks in terms of conversation design and understands how tone, structure, flow, context collection, and escalation timing shape the member experience.
* Technically comfortable working with integrations, workflow builders, configuration tools, and operational systems without requiring engineering support for every change.
* Understands that enabling AI agents to take action requires careful attention to guardrails, edge cases, validation, privacy, compliance, and safe execution paths.
* Uses metrics such as automation rate, containment, resolution rate, CSAT, escalation rate, repeat contact, and defect trends to evaluate whether AI capabilities are working and where to iterate.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to work across business and technical teams, manage ambiguity, and deliver measurable outcomes through iterative improvement.
* Sound judgment regarding member experience, operational risk, compliance, privacy, and data handling expectations.

**Physical / Mental Requirements and Demands**

* Work requires a normal range of hearing, vision, and verbal communication skills, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Must be able to use telephone, headset, keyboard, and standard office equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Ability to perform work at a computer station for extended periods and function in an environment with frequent interruptions is required.

Reporting to the Accounts Receivable Supervisor, the Accounts Receivable Assistant collaborates with Accounts Receivable colleagues, Billing Specialists, Cash Applications, Business Operations, and Financial Systems Support to help ensure timely, accurate service to internal stakeholders and clients. This role supports the firm’s accounts receivable operations by responding to payment and invoice inquiries, coordinating monthly statements, reviewing account information, and maintaining accurate collection activity records. The Accounts Receivable Assistant serves as a liaison between attorneys, clients, and internal teams, coordinating inquiries and requests related to outstanding balances, invoices, and payment activity to ensure timely, accurate, and professional responses.

  

This position will reside in our Philadelphia and offers a hybrid in-office/remote working schedule.

* Contact clients at the direction and supervision of team members.
* Support ARCS functions.
* Support Mid-Year and Year-End Countdown communications, reporting, and statistics.
Contribute to special projects, including paid-on-account balance reviews, and perform other related duties as assigned.

**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Position: Associate Director Operations**

**Entity: Clinical Practices of University of Pennsylvania**

**Department: Radiation Oncology**

**Location:** **Perelman Center for Advanced Medicine-3400 Civic Center Blvd**

**Hours: Full Time**

**Summary:**

Working in collaboration, the (Associate) Director will be instrumental in developing and implementing initiatives between multiple locations and CPUP leadership to improve patient access and overall operations of large multidisciplinary ambulatory facilities. Engage with practice administrators, managers and employees in delivering patient care services consistent with the Ambulatory Principles of Practice. Partners with functional areas to ensure a positive patient experience, and a clean and safe environment of care for practices to deliver care to patients. The incumbent will also provide leadership in the areas of: Care coordination with relevant diagnostic and supportive services; integration with multiple specialties; efficient access management processes in coordination with referral sources; sustained patient satisfaction and quality initiatives for the disease-based programs.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Leadership on Operations, Clinical Management and Program Development:
* Serves as a core resource for the shared services.
* Under the direction of senior leadership, works closely with departmental leadership ensuring a unified and effective approach to patient access initiatives. Ensures a sound operating model for communication and collaboration with referring physicians.
* Ensures compliance with the CPUP Principles of Practice, as they may be amended from time to time, across the Center and Service Line.
* Establishes and maintains a transparent and data-driven culture in managing operations and access by implementing patient pathway value stream improvement initiatives across the disease-based programs.
* Serves as point coordinator and leader for select CPUP functions as required or needed. With other service line leaders, develops and standardizes metrics that facilitate communication and management by metric culture.
* Establishes a working knowledge of management and clinical information systems (PennChart, etc.); effectively using these tools to monitor and improve work flow, revenue cycle performance, patient access and service performance.
* Addresses interdepartmental barriers to delivery of care including staffing, equipment and facilities. Ensures that care delivery is consistent with policies and standards, federal and state laws and regulations, and accreditation requirements.
* Accountable to Senior Director of Operations and stakeholder clinical departments for managing shared service expense and departmental outpatient visit budgets, and providing regular variance analyses.
* Quality:
* Promotes continuous improvement and integration in methods of patient care delivery and operations. Establishes patient focused performance expectations by creating clearly defined performance goals and measures. Proactively implementing steps to maintain and improve quality of service for clinical staff, patients and visitors.
* Integrates evidence-based patient safety principles in all practice activities/initiatives. Fosters a culture of safety, encouraging reporting of occurrences and near misses.
* Work with leadership to develop and implement comprehensive plans for performance improvement programs. Facilitates integration of quality initiatives and activities across inpatient, outpatient and other entities.
* Assures compliance with institutional and national practice standards, applicable laws and board policies. Keeps abreast of current regulatory standard; develops and/or implements plan to address changes in standards. Ensures efficient and supportive health care services to all patients.
* Program Development and Support:
* Works with leadership as well as CPUP, HUP, and Departmental leadership as requested in developing programs, services, and initiatives across the Health System that anticipate future customer needs, build customer loyalty, and generate profitable growth.
* Defines staffing requirements that are congruent with the mission and goals of the department. Ensures selection and utilization of qualified, competent personnel. Uses appropriate efficiency information/data (i.e., benchmarking, market analysis, program changes) to determine staffing requirements. Provides opportunities for staff growth within area of specialty, which is reflected in professional/performance plans.
* Team Building and Professional Development:
